pages.text: A single-rank ability for the Dragon Staff only. Costs one ability slot, one Nether Star, one Phantom Membrane, one Piercing enchanted book of any level, and 10 Redstone Blocks.

Right-click while riding a deployed stage-three or older dragon to grab a small enemy ahead, shake and bite it, then let go. The target must be smaller than an Iron Golem. Ice and Fire handles bite damage. Each dragon has a 20-second cooldown.
